title: Censor Check: a research-use audit of censored potency data
description:
Censor Check reports what an exact-value (pChEMBL-style) filter removes from an IC50 table, estimates the resulting potency bias with pooled and grouped censored-normal likelihoods, separates record-weighted, paper-weighted and threshold-reachable summaries, compares strata pooled and within papers with Mantel–Haenszel weighting, checks counter-screen censoring and disguised ceilings, and reproduces the numbers of its companion article, The Audit, No. 1, "Where the Inactives Went," from a bundled ChEMBL subset (CC BY-SA 3.0).

Research-use alpha. Estimates describe datasets, not compound potencies. Numerical verification is not biological validation.

Live tool: https://datarichinsightpoor.github.io/censor-check/ · Methods: https://datarichinsightpoor.github.io/censor-check/methods.html
